text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Japanese Derby, and<n>Grass Wonder
is set for her clash<n>with El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
She's tense, knowing that if she<n>can't overcome
her contemporary<n>rivals, defeating the "Beast" will
remain no more than a dream.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One thing's for sure—we're in for an<n>intense Derby
this year!
